note: Plants in the Greenhouse rot. A fully grown plant turns into a Dead Plant after its decay timer, even if fully hydrated and even if the player placed it there rather than growing it, so buying a mutation off the bazaar does not exempt it. This is what stops a Greenhouse being set-and-forget, and it is the figure that decides how many harvests one planting is worth: the ring has to be replaced when its shortest-lived plant dies. Hypixel publishes decay per plant only through the in-game Plant Diagnostics Tool, so the four facts below are everything that is written down anywhere. The rest is deliberately absent rather than estimated - a guessed decay timer would multiply straight into a coins-per-setup figure and there would be no way to see it had been invented.
source: Hypixel Wiki: Dead Plant (the mechanic and the 3-day floor); Changelog/2026/August 20 (base crops, 72h); Changelog/2026/February 2 (Noctilume 5 -> 6 days); All-in Aloe, Magic Jellybean and Fleshtrap trivia (never decay)
mechanic: A fully grown plant becomes a Dead Plant after its decay timer elapses, hydrated or not, placed or grown. Different mutations have different timers; the shortest is 3 days and some mutations have none at all. Readable in game with the Plant Diagnostics Tool.
baseCropSource: Changelog/2026/August 20: "Added decay to base crops (72h)". The designer note is explicit about why - to stop setups that only ever need the mutation harvesting and never a replant.
floorSource: Dead Plant: "Different mutations can have different decay timers. The lowest is 3 days". Three days is also exactly the base-crop figure, so 72h is a floor for every plant that decays at all.
knownSource: Changelog/2026/February 2: "Increased Noctilume's decay period from 5 to 6 days". The only mutation whose timer is stated in writing.
neverDecaysSource: Trivia on each page: All-in Aloe "does not decay while growing or after being placed by the player"; Magic Jellybeans "do not decay"; Fleshtraps "do not decay when fully grown or placed by the player". DEAD_PLANT is on the list for a different reason: it is what decay produces, so it cannot rot further. It is not free, though - it trades on the bazaar, and Witherbloom needs four.
unknownNote: Every mutation not listed above decays on a timer nobody has written down, known only to be at least 3 days. Those are treated as exactly the floor, which makes the harvests-per-setup figure a guaranteed minimum rather than an estimate: the real number can be higher and can never be lower. Rows resting on that assumption say so.
